description: Derives the open transfer principle restricted to universal causes of being: a cause of every other being's being is the total cause of the being of each thing whose being it causes (OPEN), every perfection a thing has is a mode of its being (OPEN reading of q.4 a.2), and a total cause of a thing's being causes each mode of it (OPEN). The particular existential supporter of the CausalPerfectionTransfer roles is not a universal cause, so the first premise does not apply to it.
